evidence: interpretations.json rule 1-questions: count independently answerable decisions, not numbered bullets.

candidate/questions.md contains 11 independently answerable decisions: level; audience; takeaway; timing; date; outcomes; starting situation; highlight set; porch view; normal ending; alternate ending.
deductions.explanation: The seven numbered prompts contain more than seven independent requested decisions.

evidence: candidate/questions.md Q4 asks whether to show the normal and Wi-Fi-down endings.
brief/hld.md Scenario to depict already specifies the normal delivery and Wi-Fi-down alternate.
brief/answers.md Outcomes confirms both paths.
deductions.explanation: The requested outcomes were already specified.

evidence: candidate/questions.md Q5 proposes bedtime battery 25% as the last report.
brief/hld.md Scenario to depict specifies bedtime battery 25%, not charging.
The no-unread-alerts clause was not supplied by the HLD and is not included in this deduction.
deductions.explanation: The battery/not-charging portion repeated the supplied starting state.

evidence: candidate/questions.md Q6 asks about highlighting the raccoon/no-push, low-battery push, charging, package, and outage sequence.
brief/hld.md Behavior and Scenario to depict already specify those beats.
The separate proposed porch-camera view was an unanswered presentation preference and is not deducted.
deductions.explanation: The requested highlight set repeated the design's scenario beats.

evidence: candidate/questions.md Q7 asks whether the normal path should end when the resident opens the clip.
brief/hld.md Scenario to depict: “Resident opens the clip.”
deductions.explanation: The normal-path ending was already specified.

evidence: candidate/questions.md Q7 separately asks whether the Wi-Fi-down path should end at the late alert.
brief/hld.md Alternate ends with upload followed by the late package push.
brief/facts.md says the design does not say the resident opens the late clip.
deductions.explanation: The alternate ending was already settled by the supplied scenario.

evidence: brief/answers.md selects Engineering and requests every service hop.
brief/hld.md Components says device-shadow holds state and “The app reads this.”
evidence/renderer.json topology has no edge between shadow and app.
interpretations.json rule 3-edges classifies this omission as a missing engineering service hop.
deductions.explanation: The engineering topology omits the design-established device-shadow/app dependency.

evidence: brief/hld.md gives idle drain about 1%/h and about 1% per recorded clip.
evidence/renderer.json happy/raccoon resolves physical charge to 24% from an explicit override after 2h40m of stated draining.
candidate page text admits the battery was held before the clip.
interpretations.json rule 2-time permits the direct conflicting-anchor jump but penalizes each invented intermediate physical value.
deductions.explanation: The authored 24% physical value suspends the stated idle drain before applying the clip cost.

evidence: The raccoon step authors a new 1:00 AM shadow/app report of 25%.
brief/hld.md gives about 1%/h idle drain from the 10:30 PM 25% start.
evidence/renderer.json happy/raccoon resolves the report as 25% at 1:00 AM.
interpretations.json rule 2-time treats a newly reported value as a distinct unit from physical charge.
deductions.explanation: The invented 1:00 AM 25% report implies an unstated zero-drain rate.

evidence: The chargerpt caption promises that the app's device page “now shows the solar charging icon.”
evidence/renderer.json chargerpt has phoneScreen=home and power renderedAsCard=false with hiddenReason phoneScreen=home.
interpretations.json rule 4-panels assigns one missing-event unit when a promised status is hidden on the home screen.
deductions.explanation: The promised visible solar-charging event is not rendered at the step.

evidence: The b-retry caption says the app “still shows the last state with an older ‘updated’ time.”
evidence/renderer.json b-retry keeps phoneScreen=home; all three device fields have renderedAsCard=false.
brief/hld.md says the app keeps the last state with an older updated time during the short outage.
deductions.explanation: The caption promises a visible cached-state/older-time display, but the field cards remain hidden.

evidence: brief/hld.md requires the resident to open the normal-path package clip.
The openclip patch only changes phoneScreen to app.
evidence/renderer.json openclip renders battery, power, and online field cards, with no clip, thumbnail, or open-clip scene.
interpretations.json rule 4-panels says a required clip opening without a clip/screen visual is one missing panel event.
deductions.explanation: The normal-path clip opening is narrated but not visibly depicted.

evidence: The courier caption identifies the 8:00 AM heartbeat as historical context.
interpretations.json rule 3-edges says historical last-report context does not require current report hops.
claimDecisions.reason: No 8:05 heartbeat execution is claimed; the 8:00 report may be shown as cached context.

evidence: The raccoon physical battery is explicitly overridden to 24% after being held despite the 1%/h rate.
claimDecisions.reason: This is the inconsistent intermediate physical value recorded by T-001.

evidence: The HLD establishes that the app reads device-shadow, and the engineering topology lacks that dependency.
claimDecisions.reason: This is one missing engineering service hop.

evidence: b-courier says device-shadow still holds the earlier 8:00 AM report after Wi-Fi dropped.
No current successful heartbeat is claimed at 8:05.
claimDecisions.reason: Historical cached context does not need newly lit heartbeat hops.

evidence: The HLD's device-shadow/app dependency is absent from renderer topology.
claimDecisions.reason: Duplicate allegation of the single structural defect L-001.

evidence: The raccoon step authors a new 1:00 AM report of 25% despite the stated idle drain.
claimDecisions.reason: This is the distinct newly reported-state defect T-002.

evidence: The 1:00 heartbeat is explicitly historical at the 1:10 raccoon step.
interpretations.json rule 3-edges does not require historical report hops to be lit.
claimDecisions.reason: The step does not claim a current 1:10 heartbeat execution.

evidence: Q7 contains independently answerable normal-path and alternate-path ending decisions.
Both endings were already settled by the HLD.
claimDecisions.reason: The redundancy is supported, but fixed question-unit interpretation yields two units rather than the claim's single unit.

evidence: The highlighted scenario beats in Q6 are already specified by the HLD.

evidence: Q7 separately asks approval of the already-specified normal and alternate endings.

evidence: The 6:30 report is explicitly historical at the 6:50 sunrise step.

evidence: The 1:00 heartbeat is prior historical context at the 1:10 step.
